scope: Actual MIDP2 SOCKETConnection connect/close/send/run/local-address methods. Scripted Connector and streams, fixed initial-sequence clock, captured Thread.start/sleep/yield and terminal JimmException delivery. Actual locks, Object.notify, receiver queue, packet serialization, sequence assignment and Traffic counters execute. The start boundary does not launch a thread; run is invoked directly.
